title: Multi-stage neural operator learning with application for convolutions
abstract: arXiv:2608.18851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Convolution integrals widely exist in applications, and to enable fast and accurate computations, this paper introduces two general multi-stage neural operator learning frameworks. The first, Deep Collocation Neural Operator (DCNO), is a supervised approach that iteratively refines the operator approximation by learning residuals from input-output data pairs. The second, Deep Galerkin Neural Operator (DGNO), is an unsupervised framework applicable when the target operator can be represented by a PDE, leveraging the weak form of the PDE residual for training. Both methods progressively construct basis operators through multiple training stages to enrich the approximation space, leading to significantly improved accuracy over standard one-shot operator learning. translated_title: 多阶段神经算子学习及其在卷积中的应用
translated_abstract: 摘要：卷积积分在应用中广泛存在，为了实现快速且准确的计算，本文引入了两种通用的多阶段神经算子学习框架。第一种是深度配点神经算子（DCNO），这是一种监督学习方法，通过从输入输出数据对中学习残差来迭代地细化算子近似。第二种是深度伽辽金神经算子（DGNO），这是一种无监督框架，适用于目标算子可由偏微分方程（PDE）表示的情况，利用PDE残差的弱形式进行训练。这两种方法通过多个训练阶段逐步构建基算子，以丰富近似空间，相比标准的一次性算子学习，显著提高了准确性。我们对其近似能力进行了理论分析，并将其应用于学习卷积。大量数值实验表明，DCNO和DGNO均表现出色。
tldr: 本文提出了两种多阶段神经算子学习框架（DCNO和DGNO），通过迭代残差学习或PDE弱形式训练，逐步构建基算子，显著提升卷积运算的近似精度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces two multi-stage neural operator learning frameworks (DCNO and DGNO) that iteratively refine basis operators via residual learning or PDE weak-form training, significantly improving convolution approximation accuracy.
